{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == 999999.99

# Filter for LOYAL customers, completed orders, exclude QA, and exclude refunded
# 'completed' means status == 'completed' — refunded should be excluded
loyal_completed_final = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
                              (sales['status'] == 'completed') & 
                              (~qa_mask)]

# Verify no QA orders remain
qa_in_final = len(loyal_completed_final[loyal_completed_final['revenue'] == 999999.99])

# Verify no refunded orders remain (they should not be in 'completed')
refunded_in_final = len(sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
                              (sales['status'] == 'refunded')])

# Calculate mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_final['revenue'].mean()

# Print results
print(f'QA orders in final set: {qa_in_final}')
print(f'Refunded orders in LOYAL segment: {refunded_in_final}')
print(f'Mean revenue of completed LOYAL orders (final): {mean_revenue}')"}
